Read 2026-10-02. src/config.yaml is outside the directories the ledger extractors scan, so it has no source rows; its copy is the default title 'Fractional Chief AI Officer' and the default description 'Fractional AI leadership for 30–300 person companies: AI governance that passes procurement and agentic automation shipped to production.' The default title matches the home page: the built home <title> is 'Fractional Chief AI Officer — meshin.co'. The default description does NOT match the home page: src/pages/index.astro and the STATIC_PAGE_CATALOG entry for '/' in src/utils/machine-text.mjs both carry 'Fractional Chief AI Officer for 30–300 person companies: governance that passes enterprise procurement, and agentic systems shipped to production with evals.' The config description ships as the llms.txt tagline and as the channel description of rss.xml, the six per-collection rss.xml feeds and feed.json, where no ledger row covers it. Reported, not fixed: the site has two different taglines. Status stays verified because each string is correct on its own; they disagree with each other.

Read 2026-10-02. No prose: the file holds formatting and trimming functions (firstSentence, teaser, clauseTrim, pageTitle, faqDescription, faqMetadata), numeric limits (140-character teaser, 12-word floor, 70-character title, 120 to 160 character description) and regular expressions. It has no ' — meshin.co' literal: the title suffix comes from titleSuffix(brandFromDisk()) in src/utils/brand.mjs, which reads site.name from src/config.yaml. The strings it builds are rows on the /faq routes, not here.

Read 2026-10-02. No prose: 'Fraunces' and 'IBM Plex Sans' are font-family names in inline style objects, the colours are hex values, title, eyebrow and footer are passed in by the caller, and the brand text is read from src/config.yaml through brand.mjs. The extractor now produces no row for this file, which is correct; the earlier suggestion that 'IBM Plex Sans' was an extractor false positive is closed. The text this template lays out appears only inside the /og/*.png images.
